title: Was so excited…but…
text: So this was a gift for my 9 year old son for Christmas, starting with the November box that didn’t come - so I had to just tell him about it. I’m not sure which month was the Eternals box, but our Ikaris Funko will not stand at all. It’s junk and frustrating. We’ve tried everything…we weren’t overly disappointed with the Last box although I had to take the Thor shirt since my son won’t wear it. The Funkos were better and stand at least. We are awaiting boxes, and the uncertainty of arrivals is honestly a bummer - esp for a 9 year old who was gifted this for Christmas.
label: negative
